conversation.user: I'm considering the Construction Management Diploma. Give me a brief introduction.
conversation.advisor:
The **Construction Management Diploma** is a **part-time, blended** program offered through BCIT’s **School of Construction and the Environment**, with study available at the **Burnaby Campus and online**.

It develops technical and general skills for construction project management, including construction processes, estimating, contracts, project management, building codes, economics, sustainability, and communication. The program consists of **75 credits**: **69 credits of required courses** plus **at least 6 credits of electives** from the approved elective pool.

Graduates may also continue their education through the **Bachelor of Technology in Construction Management** pathway.

[View the full program details](https://www.bcit.ca/programs/construction-management-diploma-part-time-7710dipma/)
